title: Coca Cola
description: Adds a new item to the game that is coca cola
body:
# Coca Cola in Minecraft

This datapack adds a new item to your game: Coca Cola! Now you can drink it and get a little boost. It's just like a normal drink but cooler cuz it's Coke lol. Perfect for surviving or just chillin' in your world.

Install and enjoy a sip of soda while mining or fighting mobs. It's really simple to use, just craft or give yourself a Coke and drink it!
